notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch only (requests + bs4, Chrome UA), no blocks encountered - robots.txt is a standard Shopify agent policy (User-agent: * / Allow: /, no Claude-specific disallow), so tier (a) and tier (c) both permitted; (b)/(c) not needed. TREE: union of homepage mega-menu (collections/* links extracted from rendered nav HTML) + /sitemap_collections_1.xml (312 collection URLs) + each candidate category page's own sub-nav/filter links. Site is a Shopify store (Bloomr, UAE floral/home-decor retailer) whose primary business is artificial flowers/plants/trees; Furniture, Lighting, Kitchen&Dining/Tableware, Wall Decor/Home Decor already covered by other workbooks. QTY: read from each collection page's rendered pagination header 'facets__label' text ('1-N of TOTAL products'), confirmed present on every recorded row. Confirmed h1 matches requested node on every leaf. EXCLUDED and why: (1) Mattresses (1 product, /collections/mattresses) - mattress itself is not a textile product per textile.md (only protectors/toppers would qualify, none present). (2) Duvet Covers/Pillow Covers/Flat&Fitted Sheets TC300/TC500/TC700 filter pages (duvet-covers-tc300/500/700, pillow-covers-300/500/700tc, flat-fitted-sheets-300/500/700tc) - these are attribute-filtered subsets of the same parent product set (overlapping, not disjoint hierarchy children; found only as unlabeled filter links on the parent page, not in main mega-menu or as a labeled sub-nav) - recording both parent and filters would double count overlapping products, so only the parent (Duvet Covers/Pillow Covers/Flat & Fitted Sheets) was kept. (3) Cushion Fillers (/collections/cushion-fillers, 10 products) - loose stuffing/insert products, 4 of its 10 products are literally cross-listed duplicates of the Pillows collection; not a distinct nav category and materially a non-fabric filler/notion item, excluded to avoid double counting with Pillows. (4) Napkins & Napkin Holders (/collections/napkins-napkin-holders, 10 products total) - only 2 of 10 products are actual napkins (textile); majority (8/10) are napkin holders (non-textile tableware/decor accessory, not covered by Storage rules either); no separate URL exists for napkins-only, so primary product type of this merged listing is non-textile and the whole node was excluded from both arrays. (5) Bathroom Accessories (/collections/bathroom-accessories, 8 products) - mixed marble accessory sets + 3 towels; the 3 towels are duplicates of the dedicated Towels collection already recorded, majority of the page is non-textile decorative marble accessories, so excluded to avoid duplication. (6) Baskets (/collections/baskets, 14 products, nav label 'Baskets & Rattan') - browser title/meta explicitly frame it as 'Baskets & Rattan Decor', products are generically named with no material/purpose description; per storage.md Sec.5 a decorative basket with no confirmed storage function should follow the site's own category framing, and this one is framed as decor (grouped under Home Decor menu with vases/candles/mirrors, not any storage/organization section) - excluded from Storage. (7) Decorative Boxes & Jewelry Boxes (/collections/decorative-boxes, 145 products) - inspected product slugs: mix of jewelry-box/jewellery-box/jewel-box items alongside clearly decorative items (decorative-tray, decorative-bowl, decorative-pot, decorative-horse-on-base, lioness-box, beatles-box); page explicitly titled 'Decorative Boxes & Jewelry Boxes' - excluded as a parent node (decorative-first framing), but see included row below. (8) Decorative Box (/collections/decorative-box, 14) and Glass Tray & Box (/collections/glass-tray-box, 6) - sitemap-only tag collections, both explicitly decorative (trays/objects), excluded per storage.md Sec.24. (9) Sideboards & Cabinets, TV Units, Display Units, Bedside Tables etc - explicitly listed under the site's 'ALL FURNITURE' mega-menu, excluded per storage furniture boundary (site's own Furniture placement controls). INCLUDED with review flag: Jewelry Box (/collections/jewelry-box, 127 products) - a sitemap-only tag collection (not in main mega-menu) cleanly isolating the jewelry-box subset of the mixed Decorative Boxes & Jewelry Boxes parent; jewelry/jewellery organizers are explicitly Storage per storage.md Sec.7, included at MEDIUM confidence since the parent collection framing is decorative and this is a sitemap-discovered subset rather than a primary-nav category. Pillows (/collections/pillows, 4 products) - inspected products are fiber/goose-down filled pillow inserts (not pillowcases); kept as Textile under Bedlinen & Towels bedding menu at LOW confidence given the filler/insert nature is a boundary case per textile.md Sec.22. Placemats (/collections/placemats, 18) kept at MEDIUM confidence - product type 'Placemats' is explicitly listed in textile.md Sec.7 but material (fabric vs other) could not be confirmed from product pages (no description text on this store; likely a demo/staging content snapshot with placeholder product names and template descriptions across the whole catalog). Rugs & Carpets hierarchy reconstructed from mega-menu column headings 'Rugs' (rectangular+round=454, matches parent) and 'Premium Handmade Rugs' (rectangular-1 14 + round-circular 0 =14, matches its own parent count of 14), all summing correctly to the top Rugs & Carpets total of 468 - parent URLs dropped per parent-category-URL rule since valid subcategories exist and fully account for the totals.
